name: Hands
overview: Scripture reveals that hands are instruments of both spiritual expression and diligent service. Lifting up hands in worship and prayer, as seen in Psalms 28:2 and 134:2, signifies dependence on God and blessing Him, while the work of hands is to be established and done with might according to Psalms 90:17 and Ecclesiastes 9:10. Hands also demonstrate compassion and generosity, as Proverbs 31:20 highlights reaching out to the needy. The act of holding up hands in battle, like Moses in Exodus 17:11, shows the power of intercession and faith in God’s victory.
